content: mina (Design): quick a11y note on the stacked area chart legend — keyboard users can't see which item is focused when tabbing. visual hover exists but no keyboard focus state. screenshot: https://img.redwood/stacked/legend.png :mag: ash (Frontend): that's the compact legend above the chart, right? we render items as spans for perf. mina (Design): yep. hover gives underline; tab shows nothing. also swatch borders are thin and lose contrast on patterned backgrounds. lina (A11y): make legend items real buttons (or role=button) with tabindex, add aria-pressed for toggle state, and a clear focus outline. For focus use a 3px solid outline that meets 3:1 against chart bg. Also ensure the swatch has at least 3:1 border contrast when focused. ash (Frontend): current markup: `Errors` ash (Frontend): proposed: `` lina (A11y): good. add `aria-live=\"polite\"` announcer that says e.g. \"Errors series hidden\" when toggled. Debounce updates (350ms) to avoid spamming when toggling multiple series quickly. ben (QA): tests: keyboard: tab to legend, Enter/Space toggles, focus ring visible in both themes, toggling updates aria-pressed and announcer reads correct phrase. Matrix: VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS. mina (Design): small copy nit: announcer message should be short: \"Errors hidden\" / \"Errors visible\" instead of longer phrases. lina (A11y): agreed. also check that focus order remains logical (legend -> chart -> controls) and that tooltips are reachable via keyboard. Avoid relying on hover-only tooltips. ash (Frontend): will implement button markup, focus outline, swatch border tweak, aria-live announcer with debounce, and unit tests. estimate 2.5 dev hrs + 1 QA. PR -> https://git.redwood/pr/10234 (WIP). deploy preview -> https://deploy-preview.redwood/10234 ci-bot: accessibility-lint: legend-focus (medium), legend-contrast (low) https://ci.redwood/a11y/2440010000 lina (A11y): i'll review the PR and run VoiceOver+NVDA checks. ping me when ready. mina (Design): thanks all :thumbsup:
